# jpeg-js decoder 0.4.4

Source: npm package `jpeg-js@0.4.4`, `lib/decoder.js`. Upstream CommonJS/browser export is replaced by one ESM default export. Decoder copyright/Apache 2.0 notice is retained in the source. Package BSD license is retained in LICENSE. Use typed-array mode and strict, bounded decoding in the calling sanitation boundary. This source is server-only.

Trailing whitespace is normalized in the vendored source and license text; notices and license terms are preserved.
